### OOS_1: Production external-agent launchers can still hang when installed binaries are unhealthy
- **Description**: `scripts/run-external-agent.sh`, `plan-review-loop.sh`, and launcher libs lack a fast-fail health probe or shorter timeout. Installed-but-unhealthy Codex/Cursor binaries (auth failure, quota exhaustion, or network issue) can block production runs outside of test harnesses. Reviewers marked this as pre-existing and intentionally deferred from #3338. Suggested fix: add a configurable health-probe timeout (e.g. `LARCH_EXTERNAL_HEALTH_CHECK_TIMEOUT`) and fast-exit path in `run-external-agent.sh` when the probe fails, so production runs degrade gracefully to Claude instead of blocking.
- **Reviewer**: Cursor review panel (round 1)
- **Vote tally**: YES=3 NO=0 EXON=0
- **Phase**: implement
